expect_red: a layout that leaves a part unplaced, places one the model has not, or routes through a box says so in its notes rather than drawing something else

mutations.contract: An unplaced top-level part is a layout defect reported in notes, never drawn at an invented place.
mutations.note: Places an unplaced part at the origin cell and says nothing, so the part is drawn and the note is missing.
mutations.find: else notes.push("part " + p.id + " has no place in the layout");
mutations.replace: else placeOf[p.id] = [0, 0]; /* mutated: an unplaced part is drawn at the origin cell */
